rows.law: Self-eval with gold receipts: grade the harness against its own sealed answers, keep the receipt on file, re-run it
rows.claim: Estate self-eval claims precision/recall 1.0 on 10 identities / 30 records with a gold receipt on file
rows.quote: The task answered by itself: every required record cited verbatim
rows.steal: Give every eval harness a --grade-gold mode that answers the task with itself; the run is the standing proof that each gold url still carries its quote
rows.falsifier: A fresh --grade-gold diverges from the sealed receipt, or a re-fetched page no longer carries a gold excerpt

rows.law: Precision is over distinct member identities; duplicate identities collapse to their worst score
rows.claim: Identity resolution: over-delivery and duplicate claims cannot inflate precision
rows.quote: duplicate identities collapse to their worst score (paper, recall section)
rows.steal: Dedupe by identity before averaging precision in any benchmark; duplicates must always pay the worst score, never the best
rows.falsifier: A submission that scores a duplicated identity at full value twice without collapsing

rows.law: Soft and hard F1 over a claim(n) -> field(m) -> url(k) hierarchy with per-parent count floors
rows.claim: WANDR's scoring protocol is the ready-made eval shape for estate research runs
rows.quote: soft/hard F1 over qualification key hierarchies
rows.steal: Score hierarchies twice: soft (partial credit per required field) and hard (all-or-nothing per member), with zero-padded recall against required counts
rows.falsifier: Soft and hard F1 reported identical on a submission with partial members (soft must exceed hard)

rows.law: Stub judge honesty: a placeholder scorer is named STUB at the point of use, with the swap path named
rows.claim: Task-specific verdicts here are deterministic gold-excerpt containment, not WANDR's LLM judge
rows.quote: The task-specific checks are a STUB judge: deterministic containment of the gold
rows.steal: Label every placeholder scorer STUB in its own docstring and output; never let containment checks masquerade as LLM judgment
rows.falsifier: A score reported as LLM-judged that is actually substring containment, or a stub with no named replacement path

rows.law: Per-parent count floors are load-time errors, never silent degrades
rows.claim: A task short of its floors refuses to load (ValueError), so an under-shaped task can never be scored
rows.quote: a parent short of its floor is a task error
rows.steal: Enforce structural floors (claims x fields x urls minimums) at load with a hard raise; refuse to score a malformed task into partial numbers
rows.falsifier: A task below its floors loads and produces a score instead of ValueError
